title: Introducing VPC-isolated Postgres on Mastra Platform
body_markdown:
You can now attach a[VPC-isolated Postgres](https://mastra.ai/docs/mastra-platform/database#providers) database to any environment on Mastra platform, letting you restrict access to same-network resources.


Typically, hosted databases are accessible from any client. Mastra platform's VPC provides an extra layer of security by preventing access from resources hosted outside the network.


Your browser does not support the video tag.


In June, we launched[managed databases](https://mastra.ai/blog/introducing-managed-databases) with Turso and Neon. VPC Postgres joins the lineup for use cases where extra restrictions are required, with MongoDB and Redis coming soon.


When using a VPC-provisioned database,` --region` doesn't apply. The platform deploys the database to the same region as the environment to ensure it uses the same server network.


## Get started


Install or upgrade the global Mastra CLI:


Terminal


```text
npm   install   -g   mastra@latest
```


note


Requires` mastra@1.32.0` or later, added in[PR #25650](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/25650) .


Attach a database to an[environment](https://mastra.ai/docs/mastra-platform/environments) :


Terminal


```text
mastra   env   db   create   production   --kind   postgres
```


Or leave` DATABASE_URL` in` .env` unset and let the preflight checks run when you next deploy:


```text
? Preflight needs DATABASE_URL for the production environment. Which managed database should be provisioned?
❯ Neon (serverless, public)
Postgres (VPC-isolated)
Skip — set it manually later
```


The platform injects` DATABASE_URL` at deploy time, so your[PostgresStore](https://mastra.ai/integrations/databases/postgresql) config can remain the same:


src/mastra/index.ts


```text
import   {   Mastra   }   from   "  @mastra/core/mastra  "  ;
import   {   PostgresStore   }   from   "  @mastra/pg  "  ;


export   const   mastra   =   new   Mastra  ({
// ...
storage:   new   PostgresStore  ({
id:   "  mastra-storage  "  ,
connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL  !
})
});
```


## Database status


**You can't connect to a VPC database from outside the network** . Using` psql` to connect will return an error:


```text
psql: error: could not translate host name "mastra-vpc-postgres-8d60df8b14a4.railway.internal" to address: nodename nor servname provided, or not known
```


To check the status of a VPC database, use[mastra env db show](https://mastra.ai/reference/cli/mastra#mastra-env-db-show) :


Terminal


```text
mastra   env   db   show   mastra-vpc-postgres-postgres
```


` ready` means provisioned and attached.[mastra env db list](https://mastra.ai/reference/cli/mastra#mastra-env-db-list) reports the same for every database in the project and shows which environment each one is attached to.


```text
mastra-vpc-postgres-postgres (postgres)
ID: pdb_daff2f42-6974-428e-b7e5-a4261012113d
Status: ready
Scope: environment: mastra-vpc-postgres
Region: us
Created: 2026-10-01T10:20:06.581Z


Connection env vars (injected automatically at deploy time):
DATABASE_URL=******** (use --show-secrets to reveal)
```
